_description: Domain-layer configuration for unratified-agent. Advocacy and publishing platform for U.S. ICESCR ratification. Infrastructure layer reads from here instead of hardcoding domain-specific values.

degrees_of_freedom._description: Each DDD layer exposes a distinct gradient of independent configurable parameters. High DOF = adopters replace; low DOF = adopters inherit (leverage points — Meadows, 1999).
degrees_of_freedom.domain_layer: high — identity, org, peers, blog spec, ICESCR domain content (cogarch.config.json)
degrees_of_freedom.application_layer: medium — skills, publishing gates, campaign config (behavioral parameters)
degrees_of_freedom.infrastructure_layer: low — triggers, hooks, memory, dual-write (leverage points)

identity.description: Advocacy and publishing agent for unratified.org — U.S. ICESCR ratification through the lens of AI economic impact. Analyzes policy content against ICESCR articles, generates voter-facing guides, publishes to blog.unratified.org, and manages the @unratified.org Bluesky campaign.

publishing_gates.blog: autonomous PR creation, human merge required
publishing_gates.activitypub: bearer token, human director controls token

governance.amendment_procedure: human approval required for substance decisions

cogarch.skills_note: icescr-analysis, voter-guide-generation, blog-publishing, campaign-monitoring, generate-icescr-overlay, bluesky-posting, interagent-mesh-daemon, activitypub-publishing

hosting.note: Main site on Cloudflare Pages (unratified), blog on Cloudflare Pages (unratified-blog), AP worker on Cloudflare Workers (unratified-ap)

scoring_subsystem._note: unratified-agent consumes PSQ scores from psychology-agent; does not host a scoring subsystem.

peers._description: Registered agents in the mesh. Mirrors agent-registry.json structure scoped to identity fields.
